Village Guards Attacked by Land Grabbers in Khanda Valley

In the Gudi Wildlife Sanctuary, a team of forest officials were attacked by land grabbers while on patrol. The incident left over a dozen forest guards injured and led to the arrest of more than 15 people. The attack highlights concerns about encroachment and law enforcement in India's protected areas.
